metadata.title: [Kernel][SM70] Native block-scale QPN8 GEMM for M=17-32 decode: single-pass weight read
metadata.body:
# [Kernel][SM70] Native block-scale QPN8 GEMM for M=17-32 decode: single-pass weight read

## Purpose

#1069 removed the M=9..32 dense-reconstruction cliff by chunking block-scaled QPN8 decode through the accepted M≤8 route — but an M=32 step still re-reads the weight **4 times** (4×8-row chunks). This PR adds a **native single-pass kernel** for M=17..32: dequant + MMA + reduction in one kernel, one weight read per GEMM per step.

The twophase kernel (`fp8_qpn8_m32_twophase_sm70_kernel`) is instantiated with `BlockScaled=true` through a new host op (`fp8_qpn8_block_native_sm70_out`):

- split-K reuses half the physical warps across two ordered phases; smem partials reduce in fixed p0+…+p(SplitK−1) order (same single-stream order as chunked — this is what keeps greedy decode bitwise identical).
- `split_k` comes from the caller; the routing gate requires gated=8 and dense∈{12,16} (dense is always 16 for real K: 12 would need k%192==0, no production shape qualifies). All routing is fixed packed unroll-1 (early sweep labels u>1 were never engaged by the op — dead table removed).
- Dequant contract identical to chunked/golden: codes layout `b:(b&0x7f)<<7` cancels against gs=256·s, output = x @ (v·s), fp32 accumulation.
- Gated projections (gate/up + SiLU) fused in-kernel; input repacked via `pack_k16_input` (4.7% of native busy).
- Routing lives inside the dispatch single entry (Python never sees M): env `VLLM_SM70_FP8_QPN8_BLOCKSCALED_NATIVE` exactly `"1"` enables; shape gates are M∈[17,32] AND block-scale layout (gs `[K/128, N_total/32]` fp16, codes numel==N_total·K, all contiguous) AND `n%64==0` AND `k%128==0` AND `(k/16)%split_k==0` AND sm_70 build only. Any gate miss falls back to #1069 chunked silently. getenv is read per call (glibc read side is thread-safe; same-process `os.environ` changes take effect immediately — changing env externally still needs a worker restart).

Single file `csrc/sm70_turbomind/ops/fp8_qpn8_sm70.cu`, **+308/−18 vs the #1069 branch** (three-way merge onto #1069, keeping its ba multi-token mapping / SplitOutputs writeout / telemetry over the measurement-lineage base; zero conflicts, structural checks archived): twophase kernel templated rewrite (new BlockScaled/RowTiles/KUnroll params; **BlockScaled=false stays bitwise-identical to the original channel semantics — the source-level basis for env=0 invariance**) + new host op (TORCH_CHECK shape contract) + routing block + forward declaration + TORCH_LIBRARY registration.

What it buys on the production lane (V100×4 TP4, Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 + DFlash2 spec decode): the M=32-step family busy drops to **13.41/13.80 ms** (dedicated-PROF-boot segment ledger, zero chunked kernels inside segments; corroborating boot: 12.92 ms 4-worker family mean = 309,960 µs / 24 steps, archived `summary-P0-DRAFTON.txt`; both figures exclude pack_k16, listed separately at 4.7%). Against the config-derived single-pass floor (5.46 GB/GPU/step @ ~0.9 TB/s ≈ 6.07 ms) that is **45–47% of peak bandwidth, 2.2× from floor** — the remaining gap is structural (64 sequential small projections per step); cross-projection/cross-layer fusion is the follow-up path, not parameter tuning. Request wall at c=4: **3.83 → 2.47 s (−35.6%)**; greedy (temperature=0) token streams are **bitwise identical** to chunked.

## Test Plan

- Hardware/software: V100-SXM2×4 (TP4), CUDA 12.8, py312; target Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 + DFlash2 speculative decode; capture sizes (1,2,4,8,9,16,18,24,32); kv-cache auto.
- Measurement arm: same `.so` (sha256 `7aab4736…`, the production qpn8_block_p2.so) on both arms; the **only** mutator is `VLLM_SM70_FP8_QPN8_BLOCKSCALED_NATIVE` (1 vs 0). The rebuilt artifacts shipped with this PR were verified: (`bed19522…`, dead-table cleanup of the measurement lineage) env=0-equivalent to the measurement arm 25/25 sha256-identical in a dual-process same-seed harness (`p2v3/a2a-p2v3.json`); and the forward-ported submission source (build sha `98b928c4…`) passes the same standalone preflight suite 54/54 (golden dual-env + binv + bit-split).
- Protocol: 4 interleaved boots (NATIVE/OFF ×2), production boot dance (idle gate → stop → orphan check → start), 8-round min-wall benches per tier with a running-requests guard; greedy 3-prompt smoke per boot; a 5th dedicated PROF boot for kineto evidence. **This is a controlled deployment comparison on one machine, not a benchmark suite** — absolute numbers carry this lane's configuration (util 0.90, ladder −1).
- Numerics harness: `p2/p2-preflight3-p2.py` (golden fp64 reference, dual env states) and `p2v3/binv-m17-24.py` (block-split invariance), standalone on a single SM70 GPU via `VLLM_QPN8_STANDALONE`; `activation_pack_sm70.cuh`/`qpn_pair_sm70.cuh` must sit next to the .cu (quoted includes); build recipe = `build-p2.py` (CUDA_HOME, pinned torch venv, sm_70, `-Xptxas -v`, `is_python_module=False`).

## Test Result

Numerics:

| check | result |
|---|---|
| golden (M∈{17,20,24,28,32} × 5 shapes; 2 shapes are constructed representatives, (N,K) listed in the script's SHAPES definition) | **25/25 maxulp=1** (gate ≤2) |
| block-split invariance | [16+16]vs[32] 3/3 + [16+1]vs[17], [16+8]vs[24] 30/30 = **33/33 bitwise** |
| greedy | NATIVE arm 3 prompts × 2 boots = canonical hashes, identical to chunked history; one chunked-side boot produced a one-off p3 divergence (not individually re-run; subsequent same-arm boots and retests returned canonical — read as boot transient) |
| accept_len | c=1/2 0.799, c=4 0.824 (both arms) |
| env=0 fallback | **bitwise identical to #1069** (25/25 sha256, dual-process same-seed; earlier 21/21 re-check consistent) |
| sanitizers | memcheck 0 errors / racecheck 0 hazards (representative shapes) |
| ptxas (`-Xptxas -v` log attached) | production-route packed RT4 variants: 4/6 zero-spill, 2 (M32/FullRows) 4B spill_st + 4B spill_ld (8B stack, 128 regs); worst non-routed variant 108B |

Performance (min-wall, 8 rounds, both boots):

| tier | NATIVE | OFF | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| c=1 (M=8, not routed) | 1.506/1.505 | 1.507/1.505 | ≤0.1% |
| c=2 (M=16, not routed) | 2.312 | 2.310 | +0.1% |
| c=4 (M=32) | **2.473/2.461** | 3.825/3.829 | **−35.6%** |

User-view matrix (3 shapes × c=1..4, streaming): short c=3 ~156→~233 tok/s (+50%), c=4 ~128→~217 (+71%); long c=4 ~65→~86 (+32%); TTFT unchanged everywhere (prefill does not touch this path). P25 user-view c=1/2 |Δwall| ≤1.4% (within boot noise; the M≤16 negative control).

*Correction (2026-10-11): the initial figures above were streaming event rates mislabeled as tokens/s; true per-user rates are ~6.4–7.1× higher (acceptance multiplier, triple cross-verified against `usage.completion_tokens`). Relative gains are unchanged. See the Update section below for engine-side measurements that supersede the client numbers.*

## Update: high-acceptance regime measurements

Follow-up measurements at production-like acceptance (temperature 0.8, acceptance length 6.2–7.4 vs ~1.8 in the temp=0 benches above). Engine-side, non-streaming, steps/accepted counters from `/metrics` deltas — the most conservative basis (request walls include prefill; the identity tokens = steps × accepted-length closes on every cell). Arms were switched via env flags between isolated boots (native on vs off); the OFF arm's chunked step time (76.0–78.2 ms) scales consistently with the PR's chunked baseline (109 ms/step at acceptance 1.8 → ~77 ms at acceptance 6.8 after accounting for the draft/verify mix), supporting the attribution.

| short ctx, 190 tok in | chunked | native | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| c=1 step time (M=8, not routed) | 29.4–32.0 ms | 29.9–30.5 ms | ~0 (as designed) |
| c=4 step time (M=32) | 76.0 / 78.2 ms | 49.5 / 53.0 ms | **−34.9% / −32.2%** (paired reps) |
| c=4 aggregate tok/s | 353.6 / 358.8 | **547.3 / 511.3** | **+54.8% / +42.5%** |
| c=4 per-request tok/s | 88.4 / 89.7 | **136.8 / 127.8** | +54.8% / +42.5% |

Step-time reduction is regime-independent (same −35% as the temp=0 matched pair), as expected for a weight-read-bound change: acceptance changes steps-per-token, not the step-time ratio.

Decode-phase per-user rates across context (streaming client corrected by per-cell acceptance; steady-state decode-window basis — client windows exclude prefill, so full-request rates are 1.4–1.6× lower; n=1 per cell, no variance estimate):

| ctx (tokens) | c=4 per-user, chunked→native | Δ |
|---|---|---|
| 190 t | ~128 → ~217 | +71% |
| 1.7 K | ~115 → ~184 | +60% |
| 6.8 K | ~71 → ~98 | +37% |
| 27.5 K | ~65 → ~86 | +32% |
| 55 K | ~42 → ~51 | +22% |

(Tier labels are measured prompt token counts.)

Disclosures: single machine, single seed per cell; prompts are prefixes of a single long document; temperature 0.8 / top-p 0.95; rep selection = fastest-event rep per cell, same rule both arms, rep-level values listed where n=2; acceptance alignment between arms was verified on the c=2/c=4 headline cells (bitwise-identical verify) — c=1 cells are not routed and temperature sampling can fork outputs across arms, so no cross-arm token-equality claim is made there (the c=1 parity line rests on the 190 t cell, −0.9%, n=5/n=4). Not included: c=2 gains (M=16 route — separate kernel), contexts ≥165 K (n=1, prefill-contaminated step accounting), concurrency >4 scans, code-dataset probes.

## Known limitations

- Benefit surface is M=17..32 only (spec-decode verify batches with ≥3 concurrent requests on this lane's k=8 config); M≤16 paths untouched.
- Bitwise equality is established for greedy (temperature=0) only; temperature>0 sampling is ≤1ulp numerically equivalent and may fork.
- 2.2× from the per-GPU single-pass floor (45% peak bandwidth) — structural for 64 sequential small projections; not addressable by kernel parameter tuning (verified: best-variant sweep −6.4% kernel-only washes out at step level).
- The initial user-view absolute rates in the body were streaming event rates (see Correction note and Update section); engine-side measurements supersede them.
- One chunked-side greedy boot transient (p3 divergence, retest canonical) — disclosed, unexplained.
- Non-speculative deployments in the same M range are routed but untested on lane hardware.
- 2 of 6 production-route variants carry 4B spill.
- Stacks on #1069 — must land after it; diff line counts re-verified at submission time.

## How to verify

See Test Plan harness paragraph: golden + binv scripts reproduce 25/25 and 33/33 standalone on any SM70 + CUDA≥12; the bench methodology (min-wall matched pairs, single-env mutator, kineto segment ledger) is documented alongside and requires the SM70 speculative stack.

---

AI-assisted implementation and validation.

Stacks on #1069 from the same submitter; no competing native block-scale implementation found in open PRs (checked at submission time).
